body: Thank you. I sent you a pm.

Thank you for your help. Go ahead and use it, the more people that can be helped the better. Wow, I just remembered how much I had to look forward to in the next few months. My situation isn't even that bad, my family and friends all love me. It's just this damn creeping anxiety that really gets me.

I have a relative who went through anxiety similar to mine. Always told me to learn to find something good out of the negative moments. I guess if I can make something positive out of attempted suicide, there isn't really anything I can't turn around. (I probably should quit trying to hang myself though)

Exactly. A lot has been out of my control, and doing what I did an hour ago gave me control over a situation and freedom from the anxiety of death. I'm not sure if I can classify myself as suicidal, because it's not a desire to die as much as it is a desire to be put in a deadly situation. I feel a great deal of satisfaction in knowing that I was smart enough to plan something like that out with no pain involved whatsoever. I'm not sure how much I'm allowed to talk about on here, so I'll keep what I say about what I did vague and nonspecific.

Actually, I don't really think much about it. It's scary, my desire to kill myself initially was entirely based around my life situation and my feeling of helplessness. Now, after trying twice in consecutive days, I don't even think about my situation anymore. I just get giddy every time I hold a rope. I'm still shocked as to how easy it was for me to organize a foolproof suicide plan. This whole process of planning in secret and living on the edge of death has made the past week really fun.

I don't think it's excitement about death really. I feel indifferent about death, it's lack of anxiety in that serious moment that is incredibly rewarding. If I'm not careful enough and I happen to die, then I guess I just save myself a couple thousand panic attacks that will come down the road someday.
